pr.title: Chore: Refactor TimeRangePicker for aria-label selectors
pr.body:
Refactors TimeRangePicker to move aria-label e2e selectors to data-testid.

While I was there I also changed the close calendar button to an IconButton, which ended up being a rats nest of adjusting the design to account for it. Hopefully things should be a bit better now :)
